name: Shenpan Ri
source:
The world is gradually becoming decadent and distorted in the years. Numb people are seeking for survival and change in the world. Brand has embarked on a journey with others after getting an invitation letter from the shipping country. After an unknown journey, is there redemption or deeper darkness?

[From [url=https://coolsummer-team.itch.io/judgment-day]Itch.io[/url]]
